+// updateRemoteCluster updates a remote cluster
+func (s *APIServer) updateRemoteCluster(auth ClientI, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p httprouter.Params, version string) (interface{}, error) {
+	var req createRemoteClusterRawReq
+	if err := httplib.ReadJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
+		return nil, trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	cluster, err := services.UnmarshalRemoteCluster(req.RemoteCluster)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if cluster.GetName() != p.ByName("cluster") {
+		return nil, trace.BadParameter("remote cluster name does not match request")
+	}
+	if err := auth.UpdateRemoteCluster(r.Context(), cluster); err != nil {
+		return nil, trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	return message("ok"), nil
+}

+func (s *AuthSuite) TestRemoteClusterStatusAndHeartbeat(c *C) {
+	clusterName := "remote.example.com"
+	now := s.a.clock.Now().UTC()
+	cluster, err := services.NewRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	cluster.SetExpiry(now.Add(time.Hour))
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.CreateRemoteCluster(cluster), IsNil)
+
+	checkStatus := func(status string, heartbeat time.Time) {
+		got, err := s.a.GetRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+		c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+		c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(heartbeat), Equals, true)
+		c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat().Location(), Equals, time.UTC)
+		c.Assert(got.Expiry().Equal(cluster.Expiry()), Equals, true)
+
+		stored, err := s.a.Presence.GetRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+		c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+		c.Assert(stored.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(stored.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(heartbeat), Equals, true)
+
+		clusters, err := s.a.GetRemoteClusters()
+		c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+		c.Assert(clusters, HasLen, 1)
+		c.Assert(clusters[0].GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(clusters[0].GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(heartbeat), Equals, true)
+	}
+
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline, time.Time{})
+
+	freshHeartbeat := now.Add(-time.Minute)
+	fresh, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("fresh", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: clusterName, ProxyName: "proxy", LastHeartbeat: freshHeartbeat,
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(s.a.UpsertTunnelConnection(fresh), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, freshHeartbeat)
+
+	stale, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("stale", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: clusterName, ProxyName: "proxy", LastHeartbeat: now.Add(-time.Hour),
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(s.a.UpsertTunnelConnection(stale), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, freshHeartbeat)
+
+	c.Assert(s.a.DeleteTunnelConnection(clusterName, fresh.GetName()), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, freshHeartbeat)
+
+	updatedHeartbeat := now.Add(-30 * time.Second).In(time.FixedZone("offset", 60*60))
+	stale.SetLastHeartbeat(updatedHeartbeat)
+	c.Assert(s.a.UpsertTunnelConnection(stale), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, updatedHeartbeat.UTC())
+
+	c.Assert(s.a.DeleteTunnelConnection(clusterName, stale.GetName()), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline, updatedHeartbeat.UTC())
+}
